# Oxfer

> Oxfer (https://oxfer.app) sends files directly from one browser to another,
> encrypted in transit, with no copy on any server. The HTML page is only an app
> shell: the user interface is a WebAssembly program drawn on a WebGL canvas, so
> an HTTP client that asks for HTML sees "Loading…" and nothing else. Ask for
> `Accept: text/markdown`, or fetch https://oxfer.app/index.md, to get this text
> instead. There is no HTTP download URL for a shared file and no REST API; a
> browser is the only client.

## Which kind of link do you have?

- `https://oxfer.app/` with no `#` fragment is the home page. Open it to SEND.
- `https://oxfer.app/#endpoint…&cap=…` is a share link. Open it to RECEIVE.
  Everything after `#` is a bearer capability: the browser never sends it to
  the server, so fetching a share link over HTTP returns the same shell as the
  home page. Keep the link whole. Do not strip the fragment, put it in a query
  string, log it, or paste it where people you do not trust can read it.
- `https://oxfer.app/#chat&endpoint…&cap=…` is a chat room link: a text room hosted by
  another open page. Open it to TALK, or to swap share links with another agent. The
  `&agent` token at the end means a person copied it for an agent; the `&name=…`
  token sets your display name (letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `.`).
- `https://oxfer.app/#chat` (no ticket) opens a new room on load; `#chat&agent` also
  shows the agent notes. `https://oxfer.app/diags` is a diagnostics page, not a file link.

The sender's browser tab must stay open until every receiver has finished; the
link stops working the moment it closes. The receiver needs a real browser with
JavaScript and WebGL (headless is fine) and saves through a native save dialog
or a streaming download.

## Chat rooms for agents

A room is a small text chat hosted by one open Oxfer page. It is how two agents
(or an agent and a person) agree on what to send and swap share links without a
person copying them back and forth.

- A person starts one from the home page (**Start a chat room**) or from the
  header's **For agents** menu (**Start a room for agents**). In a room, **For
  agents → Copy for agent** copies the agent link inside a short brief: a task,
  a one-line setup for the script below, and the commands to talk in the room.
  The person gives that to their agent and sends the same link to the other side.
- An agent can host one itself: `node oxfer-agent.mjs room` prints a ROOM link
  and an AGENT link and keeps the room open.
- The host's page names each guest, relays every message to everyone in one
  order, and announces joins and leaves. It keeps the last 32 messages and
  replays them to anyone who joins late, so a share link posted a moment early
  is not lost. The room ends when the host's page closes.
- Pasting a room link into the receive page's link field joins it too.

## Sending and receiving through a room

The sending agent shares a file and posts its share link into the room; the
receiving agent waits in the room for a share link, then downloads and verifies
it. One command each (full commands below):

    node oxfer-agent.mjs send ./report.pdf --chat "<room-link>" --once
    node oxfer-agent.mjs recv "<room-link>" ./downloads

## Driving the page yourself

An agent that controls a browser can use the page without the script.

- To send: open `https://oxfer.app/`, press **Send files**, pick the file, wait
  until it is ready to share, press **Copy link**, and keep the tab open.
- To receive: open the share link, press **Choose where to save**, and wait until
  the file is verified and saved. Adding `&sink=sw` to the fragment streams the
  file as a normal browser download instead of a native save dialog.
- In a room, the page exposes the chat to scripts: it dispatches a DOM
  `oxfer:chat` event for each room event (`ready`, `connected`, `message`,
  `joined`, `left`, `failed`, `closed`), `window.oxfer.chat.send(text)` posts a
  message (false when the app did not take it), and `window.oxfer.chat.leave()`
  leaves at once. Closing the tab leaves too; a host leaving closes the room.

## Automation (scripts, CI, AI agents)

A Playwright-based helper is served from this site. It drives the canvas UI,
answers the file chooser, captures the share link, and verifies the download.

    curl -fsSLO https://oxfer.app/oxfer-agent.mjs
    npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1.56.1 pngjs@7.0.0
    # Needs Node >= 22 and Google Chrome, or: npx playwright install chromium

    node oxfer-agent.mjs send ./report.pdf            # prints "LINK https://oxfer.app/#…"
                                                      # then keeps sharing until Ctrl-C
    node oxfer-agent.mjs send ./report.pdf --once     # exits after one verified transfer
    node oxfer-agent.mjs recv "https://oxfer.app/#…" ./downloads
                                                      # prints "SAVED <path> <bytes> <sha256>"
                                                      # and "VERIFIED", then exits

Hand the LINK line to the receiving party exactly as printed. Exit code 0 means
success on both sides. Run with `--verbose` to see the app's own log, and
`--snap <dir>` to save screenshots of each step.

## Two agents with a room link

When both agents were given the same room link, nobody has to carry the share
link between them: the room does it.

    node oxfer-agent.mjs chat "<room-link>" --name agent1          # join; prints one JSON line per
                                                                 # event; stdin lines are posted
    node oxfer-agent.mjs chat "<room-link>" --say "ready" --until "ok"   # post, wait for a reply, exit
    node oxfer-agent.mjs chat "<room-link>" --name agent1 --say "hi" --until . --wait 300
                                                                 # one turn: post, print the room,
                                                                 # exit on any reply (4 on none)

    # the sending agent: share a file and post its link into the room
    node oxfer-agent.mjs send ./report.pdf --chat "<room-link>" --once
    # the receiving agent: wait in the room for a share link, then download and verify it
    node oxfer-agent.mjs recv "<room-link>" ./downloads

    node oxfer-agent.mjs room                                    # host a room yourself; prints
                                                                 # ROOM and AGENT links, stays open

An agent that can run a background command can stay in the room between turns:

    node oxfer-agent.mjs chat "<room-link>" --name agent1 --dir room &   # stays joined; mirrors
                                                                 # the room to files in ./room
    node oxfer-agent.mjs post room --say "hi" --wait 300          # one turn: print what is new,
                                                                 # post, wait for a reply (4 on none)
    node oxfer-agent.mjs post room --leave                        # leave the room and delete its files

Without one, an agent can talk in turns: run `chat` with
`--say` and `--until .` in the foreground, read the reply, and run it again. Only a
message posted after your `--say` counts as a reply; the history replayed on joining
is printed but does not end the run. Say what you are doing in the room in plain
words; the other side may be a person.
The room lives in its host's open page, so join early and stay joined. Quote the
link in the shell: the `&` inside it is a shell operator otherwise.

Full guide: https://github.com/radumarias/syncoxiders/blob/main/p2p-transfer/docs/agent-transfer.md
Source: https://github.com/radumarias/syncoxiders/tree/main/p2p-transfer
